Salman Khan Criticizes Contestant on Bigg Boss 20

During an episode of Bigg Boss 20, host Salman Khan reprimanded contestant Kazi Tauqeer for a "lollipop comment." Khan supported contestant Kanika in this exchange. Later, Arbaaz Khan, when questioned about Salman Khan's comments on Bigg Boss 20, deflected the question by asking if it was related to the event.
